title: PROVISION PRAYER
PHILIPPIANS 4:19
end: The Provision Table — walk in God's daily provision

scenes.a: Bring every household bill, practical obligation, and career need before your Heavenly Father right now.
Philippians four verse nineteen declares, But my God shall supply all your need according to his riches in glory by Christ Jesus.
Psalm thirty-four verse ten assures us, They that seek the LORD shall not want any good thing.
Release anxious worry through thanksgiving and let the peace of God guard your heart and mind today.
Father, grant wise stewardship over every budget, open honest pathways of work, and surround us with favour.
God is able to make all grace abound toward you so you walk in sufficiency for every good work.
Type Amen and subscribe to The Provision Table to walk in God's daily wisdom and provision.
